Type: ottoman
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Isabel Traditional Large Storage Ottoman, 68"W, Tan
Colors: Tan
Materials: stone
67.7"W x 29.5"D x 18.9"H Polyester performance fabric on wood frame Streamlined design fits a modern or transitional room Use as an ottoman, for storage, or as an extra seat. Easy assembly in less than 15 minutes; just screw in legs Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty. This ottoman is a multi-tasker, providing a comfy foot rest along with storage space. It can accommodate a tray of snacks or be an extra seat for guests, too. Built to last, its performance fabric will resist stains along with wear and tear.
